factor: Maximum concurrent positions on the same contract: 1, 2, 3 or 9, with 9 total account slots in every case. Additional positions require a fresh original 12H V1.7 confirmation and all existing positions on that contract must be same-direction and profitable at the current observable open after taker costs on both ends. No addition based on intrabar highs/lows, no future observation, no add to a losing position.
amount: Each addition has its own stop and 75% at its own 2R, remaining 25% on V1.7 EMA exit. Open from available cash only and at most NAV/9. Open-slot count, priority, global collateral, 90-day eligibility and closes all frozen. Runs use actual entry and exit slippage to judge the mark for addition eligibility.
decision: Maximum dev value through 2024 meeting >=100 trades, >=30% winners, payoff by return >=2.5 and conservative hourly DD <=35%. Later periods previously studied; checks on selected and unconstrained development leader if new. No recalibration from full-history outcome.
